"use client";
import "./rams/styles.css";
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from "./rams/components/accordion";
export function AccordionDemo() {
    return (<Accordion type="single" collapsible defaultValue="stock" style={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: "var(--rams-detail-preview-measure-wide)" }}>
      <AccordionItem value="stock">
        <AccordionTrigger>Paper and grain</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionContent>
          Cotton stock, 180 gsm. The grain runs parallel to the fold.
        </AccordionContent>
      </AccordionItem>
      <AccordionItem value="trim">
        <AccordionTrigger>Finished format</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionContent>
          148 × 210 mm, with the long edge folded.
        </AccordionContent>
      </AccordionItem>
      <AccordionItem value="inks">
        <AccordionTrigger>Press passes</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionContent>
          Two passes: the grid first, then the terrace silhouette.
        </AccordionContent>
      </AccordionItem>
    </Accordion>);
}
export default AccordionDemo;
